source_basis: Classical prerequisites and elementary worked calculations; no new programme theorem or scientific adoption.

claims.3.1-3.7: Standard even vertex-algebra conventions and translation/locality description, with BD0.15 and3.5.9–15 as geometric interpretation.
claims.3.8-3.11: Elementary polynomial representation, normal-ordering and vacuum coefficient calculated in the chapter; executable check covers finite polynomial commutators and rejecting a wrong mode coefficient.
claims.3.12-3.13: Affine central-extension/current relation and residue derivation; invariant form is explicit.
claims.3.14-3.15: Local left/right differential-module conventions; coordinate-change structure is kept distinct from translation.
